question: What cosmic origin is attributed to the ritual substance being contemplated?
premises: It arises from a fragment of the universe
It is the source of all jewels
It is treated as a sacred substance
inference: The contemplated substance is of cosmic origin and contains the essence of all jewels.
uncertainties: Exact substance referred to is implied from surrounding verses
plain_english: It has arisen from a fragment of the universe and is the source of all jewels.
